input: # THE signature JSON Lines rule: one record per line. A value split across
# lines is not a record — it is an error.
# Nothing in the grammar states this. It falls out of the newline token
# being significant: once `#LN` leaves the IGNORE set, a newline inside a
# value is no longer invisible to the parser.
# The same value on one line is fine — this is the contrast that shows the
# rule is about layout, not content.
# Records must be SEPARATED by a newline: neither adjacency nor spaces will
# do, and a comma is not a separator (a JSONL document is not a JSON array).
